headline: Japan Considers Revising Loan Guarantee Rules for US Infrastructure Investments
summary: Japan's government is evaluating changes to NEXI loan guarantee rules to facilitate corporate funding and lower default risk classifications for investments in the US.
why: Nippon Export and Investment Insurance (NEXI) provides trade credit and investment insurance for Japanese overseas trade and corporate expansion.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Modified state credit guarantees lower financing barriers for Japanese firms investing abroad.
